contract: passwords, sessions, login throttling and origin boundaries
scenarios: password hashes are salted and reject wrong passwords
sessions expire, can be revoked and only hashes are stored
login limiting survives independent requests and resets after 15 minutes
origin must match configured origin exactly

contract: timer lifecycle across backgrounding, pause/resume and duration limits
scenarios: timer uses elapsed wall clock through background and expiry
pause, add 30, resume and skip preserve duration
running add30 caps timer at 30 minutes

contract: HTTP and workout validation preserve incomplete drafts and reject invalid completion
scenarios: JSON rejects oversized bodies, wrong content types, malformed and invalid values
drafts allow incomplete values but completed sets require reps and RIR
finish reviews and note length are constrained

contract: dictation preserves interim tails, final corrections and complete long input
scenarios: stopping retains the visible interim tail even when the final event omits it
final corrections replace interim results without duplicating earlier sentences
interim-only, empty final events and long dictations are never silently truncated

contract: durability through abrupt restart and persistent-volume enforcement
scenarios: committed SQLite WAL survives abrupt process termination
Railway refuses ephemeral database paths and missing volume

contract: repeatable migrations, foreign keys and backward-compatible exercise guidance
scenarios: migrations are repeatable and SQLite enforces foreign keys
exercise guidance migration preserves older library entries and initializes empty guidance

contract: double progression decision matrix, numeric boundaries and immutability
scenarios: 80 x 10 x 3 at target RIR recommends 82.5
first workout uses plan weight
empty previous workout uses plan weight
one set below rep ceiling prevents increase
insufficient RIR prevents increase
missing RIR prevents increase
unfinished sets prevent increase
changed set count prevents increase
mixed weights use first completed working load without increase
all unfinished uses plan weight
decimal increments avoid floating point artifacts
zero weight and RIR zero supported
above target reps still qualifies
upper supported load never exceeded
invalid parameters are rejected
input is never mutated
sign-in uses PKCE, nonce, loopback callback and persistent client for reauthorization
callback rejects state mismatch, missing code, dynamic ID and substituted client
ID token verifies signature, issuer, audience, nonce and expiry before account storage
identity alone does not grant subscription inference

contract: private credential storage, serialized refresh and lock recovery
scenarios: subscription store is owner-only and refresh is serialized without touching API key
store lock recovers from rejected operations

contract: subscription transport, stream completeness, inspectable replies and provider failures
scenarios: structured proposal sends only explicit profile and library names, never stores response
API key cannot replace missing subscription grant
incomplete outputs and refusals do not become plans
provider errors are redacted and timeouts are actionable
SSE requires terminal completion, supports chunk boundaries and stops on late limits
first-request errors distinguish app quota, temporary availability, eligibility and unknown 429 without retry
streamed text is retained if completed output is empty, without duplicating delta/done/item text
invalid, refused and empty outputs preserve public replies, not reasoning or provider credentials
incomplete or failed streams keep inspectable text but never return a plan even when its JSON is valid
oversized public replies are visibly truncated and rejected, never imported from their preview

contract: plan validation and parsing reject invalid prescriptions without guessing values
scenarios: invalid or duplicated model exercises are rejected before any import
optional profile values may be absent but implausible values and long prompts are rejected
response parsing accepts harmless number formatting but never guesses or clamps values
response validation identifies duplicates, reversed ranges and missing fields without exposing values
JSON within prose/code fences is readable, but competing or truncated objects are never guessed
AI rules and schema reject 900 reps and excessive rest; the format example is a valid small prescription

contract: plan prompts support new exercises, legacy guidance and safe video discovery
scenarios: manual ChatGPT prompt includes compact format, voluntary context and library without external call
empty libraries still allow new model exercises and older responses need no invented guidance
video search uses a fixed host and encodes exercise names without model-supplied URLs

contract: persistent AI budgets and accepted-only transactional plan import
scenarios: AI budgets share sessions, survive requests and enforce both short and daily limits
only accepted exercises are imported; matching library entries are reused; retries do not duplicate

contract: meal persistence, concurrent edits, calendar dates and partial daily totals
scenarios: diary retains meals, separates dates and rejects concurrent edits/deletes
dates and calorie totals distinguish unknown intake from actual zero

contract: nutrition response contract, uncertainty and subscription transport
scenarios: nutrition imports validate ranges and uncertainty, reject incomplete and competing JSON
nutrition uses subscription transport, strict schema and public reply without saving

contract: advice summary boundaries, missing meals, bounded excerpts and optional training
scenarios: advice summaries preserve unknown days, bound excerpts and sum every logged meal
optional training aggregate respects Berlin dates and excludes notes and unfinished sessions

contract: advice conversation persistence, follow-up context, conflicts and response validation
scenarios: saved advice freezes the summary, carries follow-up context, detects conflicts and deletes all copies
advice responses reject missing/oversized output and the prompt treats logs as incomplete data
